Found a second Clover COLO2 slug for the same store (surf-side-deli-san-diego, no '-2') via the clover.com redirect endpoint - same address (1912 Rosecrans St, confirmed in payload) and same 'SURF SIDE DELI' merchant name, same 17 numbered sandwiches as the restaurant's own homepage list. This slug's prices pass the markup test clean: cents end .99/.00/.50/.75/.25 (36 items), and no divisor 1.04-1.3 produces more than 5/36 round hits. name: Francisco's Mexican Deli
notes: Own site (franciscosmexicandelica.com) is a one-page shell with no prices; its 'Order Online' button goes to fromtherestaurant.com/franciscos-mexican-deli/locations/, a small 25KB page that needs a browser to render further - not pursued given a clean DoorDash source was in reach. Address confirmed in DoorDash JSON-LD (821 North Santa Fe Avenue, Vista). A web-search summary had quoted noticeably lower prices for overlapping items (e.g. Menudo $9.45) than DoorDash's current $13.50 - treated as a stale aggregator snapshot per house rule and discarded in favor of the page fetched directly. 'Most Ordered' section (12 items) exactly duplicated 12 of the other 39 rows - dropped. Cent endings on the 39 unique rows: .50 (22), .00 (14), .99 (3) - entirely conventional, no scattered tail. Three Sides rows (Salsa, Arroz, Frijoles) were listed as '$4.50+' etc. (a base/add-on price) - recorded the base figure and noted it as a starting price.

dishes.name: Menudo
dishes.description:
¡Menudo ardiente que calienta el alma! Sopa de pancita sabrosa, con opción de pata jugosa o con grano para un toque rústico. ¡Pide el tuyo y déjate apapachar! 
Fiery menudo that warms the soul! Savory tripe soup, with juicy pata or rustic con grano options. Order yours and feel the love!

dishes.name: Caldo De Res
dishes.description:
¡Caldo de res que revive el espíritu! Caldo robusto con carne jugosa, verduras frescas y un toque casero. ¡Puro amor en cada cucharada! 
Hearty beef caldo that lifts the soul! Robust broth with juicy meat, fresh veggies, and a homestyle touch. Pure love in every spoonful!

dishes.name: Birria Soup
dishes.description:
¡Birria ardiente que despierta los sentidos! Caldo especiado con chivo tierno o res jugosa, lleno de sabor tradicional. ¡Una explosión de gusto en cada sorbo! 
Fiery birria soup that ignites your senses! Spiced broth with tender goat or juicy beef, bursting with traditional flavor. A taste explosion in every sip!

dishes.name: Caldo De Pollo
dishes.description:
¡Caldo de pollo que abraza el corazón! Caldo dorado con pollo tierno y verduras frescas, puro consuelo casero. ¡Sabor que reconforta en cada cucharada! 
Golden chicken caldo that warms the heart! Tender chicken and fresh veggies in a comforting broth. Soul-soothing flavor in every spoonful!

dishes.name: Consomé
dishes.description:
¡Consomé puro que acaricia el alma! Caldo claro y sabroso, sazonado con amor para un deleite ligero. ¡Sencillo, pero inolvidable! 
Pure consomé that soothes the soul! Clear, flavorful broth seasoned with love for a light delight. Simple, yet unforgettable!

dishes.name: Plato de Lengua
dishes.description: Beef tongue typically cooked with guajillo chili sauce and chipotle peppers, accompanied by refried beans, Spanish rice, and two homemade flour tortillas.

dishes.name: Plato de Bistek C/ Papa En Salsa Verde
dishes.description: Steak and potatoes cooked in mild green tomatillo sauce, typically featuring jalapeño and cilantro.

dishes.name: Plato de Chille Rellenos
dishes.description: Poblano pepper typically stuffed with cheese, coated in egg batter, and fried.

dishes.name: Plato de Salmon
dishes.description: Grilled salmon typically served with rice, beans, and a tangy salsa, offering a classic Mexican plate experience.

dishes.name: Plato De Quesabirrias
dishes.description:
Plato de Quesabirrias (2–4 piezas)
¡Puro antojo hecho festín! Elige entre 2, 3 o 4 quesabirrias doraditas, rebosadas de queso derretido y birria jugosa, servidas con arroz mexicano esponjoso y frijoles bien sazonados. Acompáñalas con su consomé calientito y disfruta de un plato lleno de sabor, textura y puro gusto en cada mordida.

Quesabirria Plate (2–4 pieces)
A full-on flavor feast! Choose 2, 3, or 4 crispy quesabirrias packed with melty cheese and tender birria, served with fluffy Mexican rice and perfectly seasoned beans. Dip them in warm consommé and enjoy a plate loaded with bold flavor, rich texture, and total satisfaction.

dishes.name: Plato de Carnitas
dishes.description:
¡Platillo de carnitas que hace agua la boca! Cerdo jugoso y dorado, servido con arroz, frijoles, cebolla, cilantro, salsa y cuatro tortillas de maíz calientes. ¡Un festín mexicano inolvidable! 
Mouthwatering carnitas plate! Juicy, golden pork served with rice, beans, onion, cilantro, salsa, and four warm corn tortillas. An unforgettable Mexican feast!

dishes.name: Plato de Costillas De Puerco En Salsa Roja
dishes.description: Pork ribs simmered in a red chili sauce, offering a traditional Mexican flavor experience.

dishes.name: Mole
dishes.description:
Mole Rojo con Arroz y Frijoles
¡Un clásico que abraza el alma! Mole rojo sedoso cubriendo tu carne favorita, acompañado de arroz mexicano esponjoso y frijoles cocidos con paciencia y cariño. Cada cucharada mezcla lo ahumado, lo dulce y lo reconfortante en un plato que simplemente sabe a hogar.

Red Mole with Rice and Beans
Comfort on a plate. Smooth, rich red mole poured over your choice of meat, paired with fluffy Mexican rice and slow-cooked beans. Every bite blends smoky, sweet, and savory flavors into a warm, satisfying meal that feels like home.

dishes.name: Tamales Plate
dishes.description:
¡Dos tamales que despiertan el antojo! Elige pollo, puerco jugoso o rajas picantes, envueltos en masa suave. ¡Puro deleite mexicano! 
Two tamales that spark your craving! Pick chicken, juicy pork, or spicy rajas, wrapped in fluffy masa. Pure Mexican delight!

dishes.name: Plato de Pollo
dishes.description: Grilled chicken typically seasoned and prepared with a variety of spices, often accompanied by fresh onions, tomatoes, and jalapeño peppers.

dishes.name: Plato de Barbacoa
dishes.description:
¡Platillo de barbacoa que conquista el paladar! Carne tierna y jugosa, con arroz, frijoles, cebolla, cilantro, salsa, tortillas y un lado de consomé calentito. ¡Sabor tradicional que enamora! 
Barbacoa plate that captivates your tastebuds! Tender, juicy meat with rice, beans, onion, cilantro, salsa, tortillas, and a side of warm consomé. Traditional flavor that steals your heart!

dishes.name: ¡Huevos al Gusto!
dishes.description: Huevos preparados al gusto tipos Jamón , Chorizo, Revueltos, Estrellados, A la mexicana … acompañados con arroz y frijol y tortillas hechas a mano.

dishes.name: Marinated (Adobada) (1 Lb)
dishes.description:
¡Adobada de una libra que enciende el paladar! Carne marinada jugosa, sazonada con especias audaces, acompañada de cebolla, cilantro y salsa picante. ¡Sabor mexicano que hipnotiza! 
One-pound adobada that sets your tastebuds ablaze! Juicy marinated meat, seasoned with bold spices, served with onion, cilantro, and spicy salsa. Mexican flavor that mesmerizes!

dishes.name: Butche (1 Lb)
dishes.description:
¡Buche de una libra que deleita el alma! Crujiente y sabroso, con cebolla, cilantro y salsa picante. ¡Un manjar mexicano que te sorprenderá! 
One-pound buche that delights the soul! Crispy and flavorful, served with onion, cilantro, and spicy salsa. A Mexican treat that surprises!

dishes.name: Lengua (1 Lb)
dishes.description:
¡Lengua de una libra que derrite el paladar! Carne suave y jugosa, con cebolla, cilantro y salsa picante. ¡Un deleite mexicano que no puedes resistir! 
One-pound lengua that melts in your mouth! Tender, juicy meat with onion, cilantro, and spicy salsa. A Mexican delight you can’t resist!

dishes.name: Cabeza (1 Lb)
dishes.description:
¡Cabeza de una libra que cautiva los sentidos! Carne tierna y sabrosa, con cebolla, cilantro y salsa picante. ¡Puro placer mexicano en cada bocado! 
One-pound cabeza that captivates your senses! Tender, flavorful meat with onion, cilantro, and spicy salsa. Pure Mexican pleasure in every bite!

dishes.name: Barbacoa ( 1/2 Lb or 1 Lb)
dishes.description:
¡Barbacoa jugosa que despierta los sentidos! Elige media libra o una libra de carne tierna, con cebolla, cilantro y salsa picante. ¡Puro sabor mexicano en cada bocado! 
Juicy barbacoa that ignites your senses! Choose half-pound or one-pound of tender meat, with onion, cilantro, and spicy salsa. Pure Mexican flavor in every bite!

dishes.name: Birria (1 Lb)
dishes.description:
¡Birria de una libra que despierta el antojo! Elige chivo tierno o res jugosa, con cebolla, cilantro y salsa vibrante. ¡Sabor mexicano que te envuelve!
 One-pound birria that sparks your craving! Choose tender goat or juicy beef, served with onion, cilantro, and vibrant salsa. Mexican flavor that envelops you!

dishes.name: Asada (1 Lb)
dishes.description:
¡Asada de una libra que te hace suspirar! Carne jugosa y sazonada, con cebolla, cilantro y salsa vibrante. ¡Un festín mexicano que no olvidarás! 
One-pound asada that makes you swoon! Juicy, seasoned steak with onion, cilantro, and vibrant salsa. A Mexican feast you won’t forget!

dishes.name: Tamales (1 Dz)
dishes.description:
¡Docena de tamales que roba el corazón! Elige pollo, puerco jugoso o rajas picantes, envueltos en masa suave, con salsa verde fresca y picante o roja audaz y ardiente. ¡Un festín mexicano para compartir!
 Dozen tamales that steal your heart! Choose chicken, juicy pork, or spicy rajas, wrapped in fluffy masa, with green fresh and spicy or red bold and fiery salsa. A Mexican feast to share!

dishes.name: Burrito
dishes.description:
Burrito Regular
¡Pura sabrosura envuelta en una tortilla calientita! Elige tu carne favorita y disfrútala con arroz mexicano esponjoso, frijoles cocidos con amor, cebolla crujiente y cilantro fresco. ¡Una explosión de sabor en cada bocado!

Regular Burrito
All the flavor, wrapped and ready to go! Pick your favorite meat and enjoy it with fluffy Mexican rice, slow-simmered beans, crisp onions, and fresh cilantro—all tucked into a warm, soft tortilla. Every bite bursts with bold, delicious flavor!

dishes.name: Regular Tacos
dishes.description:
¡Tacos regulares que despiertan el hambre! Elige birria de chivo, birria de res, carnitas, barbacoa, asada, adobada, cabeza, lengua, buche o pollo, servidos con cebolla, cilantro y limones frescos. ¡Sabor mexicano auténtico en cada mordida!
 Regular tacos that ignite your hunger! Choose goat birria, beef birria, carnitas, barbacoa, asada, adobada, cabeza, lengua, buche, or chicken, served with onion, cilantro, and fresh limes. Authentic Mexican flavor in every bite!

dishes.name: Burrito with Beans, Cheese & Rice
dishes.description:
¡Burrito jugoso que satisface el antojo! Relleno de frijoles, queso y arroz, servido con salsas y opción de cebolla y cilantro. ¡Un abrazo mexicano en cada bocado! 
Juicy burrito that hits the spot! Stuffed with beans, cheese, and rice, served with salsas and a choice of onion and cilantro. A Mexican hug in every bite!

dishes.name: Tamale
dishes.description:
¡Tamal irresistible que te enamora! Elige pollo, puerco jugoso o rajas picantes, envuelto en masa suave, con salsa vibrante. ¡Un pedacito de México en cada mordida! 
Irresistible tamale that wins your heart! Choose chicken, juicy pork, or spicy rajas, wrapped in fluffy masa, with vibrant salsa. A bite of Mexico in every piece!

dishes.name: Burrito with Beans & Cheese
dishes.description:
¡Burrito sabroso que llena el corazón! Repleto de frijoles y queso derretido, servido con salsas y opción de cebolla y cilantro. ¡Puro confort mexicano! 
Savory burrito that fills your heart! Packed with beans and melted cheese, served with salsas and a choice of onion and cilantro. Pure Mexican comfort!

dishes.name: Mini Tacos
dishes.description:
¡Mini tacos que explotan de sabor! Elige birria de chivo, birria de res, carnitas, barbacoa, asada, adobada, cabeza, lengua, buche o pollo, con cebolla, cilantro y limones frescos. ¡Pequeños, pero llenos de magia mexicana! 
Mini tacos bursting with flavor! Choose goat birria, beef birria, carnitas, barbacoa, asada, adobada, cabeza, lengua, buche, or chicken, with onion, cilantro, and fresh limes. Small, but packed with Mexican magic!

dishes.name: Flour Quesadilla / Quesadilla De Harina
dishes.description:
¡Quesadilla de tortilla de harina que deleita! Queso fundido en una tortilla suave, servida con salsas y opción de cebolla y cilantro. ¡Un placer mexicano que no puedes perderte! 
Flour tortilla quesadilla that delights! Gooey cheese in a soft tortilla, served with salsas and a choice of onion and cilantro. A Mexican treat you can’t miss!

dishes.name: Corn Quesadilla / Quesadilla Maiz
dishes.description:
¡Quesadilla de tortilla de maíz que derrite el paladar! Queso fundido en una tortilla dorada, servida con salsas y opción de cebolla y cilantro. ¡Un clásico mexicano irresistible! 
Corn tortilla quesadilla that melts in your mouth! Gooey cheese in a golden tortilla, served with salsas and a choice of onion and cilantro. An irresistible Mexican classic!

dishes.name: Salsa
dishes.description:
¡Salsas que encienden tu paladar! Elige verde, fresca y picante, o roja, audaz y ardiente. ¡El toque perfecto para tu comida mexicana!
 Salsas that ignite your tastebuds! Choose green, fresh and spicy, or red, bold and fiery. The perfect kick for your Mexican meal!

dishes.name: Arroz / Rice
dishes.description:
¡Arroz mexicano que despierta el apetito! Granos esponjosos sazonados con tomate, especias y un toque casero. ¡El acompañante perfecto para tu platillo! 
Mexican rice that sparks your appetite! Fluffy grains seasoned with tomato, spices, and a homestyle touch. The perfect side for your dish!

dishes.name: Frijoles/ Beans
dishes.description:
¡Frijoles que reconfortan el alma! Suaves y sabrosos, cocidos con amor y un toque de tradición. ¡El complemento ideal para tu comida mexicana! 
Beans that comfort the soul! Soft and flavorful, cooked with love and a touch of tradition. The ideal complement to your Mexican meal!

dishes.name: Soda (1/2 Liter)
dishes.description:
¡Refresco de medio litro que alegra el momento! Elige Coca-Cola, clásica y burbujeante, o Fanta Naranja, dulce y cítrica. ¡El toque perfecto para tu comida! 
Half-liter soda that brightens the moment! Choose Coca-Cola, classic and fizzy, or Orange Fanta, sweet and citrusy. The perfect pairing for your meal!

dishes.name: Flavored Water / Agua De Sabor
dishes.description:
¡Aguas de sabor que refrescan el día! Elige jamaica, ácida y vibrante, horchata, dulce y cremosa, o tamarindo, exótico y refrescante. ¡Un sorbo de felicidad mexicana! 
Flavored waters that refresh your day! Choose hibiscus, tart and vibrant, horchata, sweet and creamy, or tamarind, exotic and refreshing. A sip of Mexican happiness!

name: Hane Sushi
sourceUrl: http://www.hane-sushi.net/media/1594/1.jpg (and 6 sibling full-res photos linked from the #menu section of the same page)
notes: Own site's #menu section links 7 full-resolution photos of the restaurant's actual printed/laminated menu (not a delivery listing) - read as images per the PDF/image-reading technique. Covers Soup, Salad, Appetizer, Kitchen, a two-column Entree/Appetizer-size teriyaki-and-tempura table (recorded both sizes as separate rows), Ice Cream, Dinner Combos (sashimi dinner, sushi/chirashi combos, don), 20 Rolls, and Sashimi Combos - all core sections for a sushi restaurant present and priced. One gap: the Nigiri/Sashimi a-la-carte price table's photo (image 6 of 7) is visibly cropped at the top edge, so it only captured 16 items alphabetically from 'Salmon Belly' onward (through 'Yellowtail Belly') plus 4 combo rows - items that would sort earlier (Albacore, Eel/Unagi, Escolar, Halibut, Mackerel, Octopus, Red Snapper, Squid, plain Salmon, etc.) were not photographed and are not in this capture. Recorded each captured nigiri/sashimi row as two dishes (nigiri single-piece price, sashimi 2pc price) since they're two genuinely different priced items, not one. Monkfish Liver has no nigiri price on the menu ('---') - only its sashimi price was recorded. Kitchen section's 6 items appear a second time verbatim atop the Dinner Combos photo - not double counted. None of the 103 prices were inferred, divided, or averaged; all read directly off the printed menu.
